accent.purpose: Primary actions, selection, active tab and nav, focus, fastest route line.

accent-soft.purpose: Selected chips, active nav pill, fastest swatch, focus halo.

on-accent.purpose: Text and icons on Route Blue.

explore.purpose: New-ground badge text, explore swatches, explore selection ring and callout text.

explore-line.purpose: Explore route strokes and recent coverage outlines.

surface.purpose: Panels, cards, menus, dialogs, map controls, callout chips.

surface-2.purpose: Resting search fill, hover rows, notices.

surface-3.purpose: Segmented track, ghost hover, neutral badges.

border-strong.purpose: Input strokes, chip and secondary outlines.

stat-lead.purpose: The single headline figure on the coverage tab.

title.purpose: Panel detail titles and the sign-in card title.

title-sm.purpose: Brand name, route durations, stat values.

body.purpose: Base text, inputs, route card titles at 600.

body-sm.purpose: Panel intros, menus, tables, notices, route metadata.

label-md.purpose: Buttons, field labels, segmented options, in-panel headings at 650.

label.purpose: Tab captions, badges, hints, table headers, small buttons.

mono.purpose: Invite codes, IDs, stack traces, log details.

map-label.purpose: Basemap labels (Noto Sans 11-13px, haloed); route callouts in Noto Sans Bold 12/13px.

themes.mechanism: prefers-color-scheme with :root[data-theme='light'|'dark'] override; dark values in colorMeta.<token>.dark

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Resting float: map controls, avatar, attribution, banners, admin cards, selected segmented option, primary hover.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Raised float: planner panel, menus, search suggestions, dialogs, toasts, chart tooltips, auth card.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs and search box, with an accent border.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected route cards and voice options.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Standard easing for all state and position transitions.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and colour changes on buttons, fields, tabs.

motion.name: duration-toggle
motion.purpose: Switch knob, tab underline, route card selection.

breakpoints.name: sheet
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: planner panel becomes a 58% bottom sheet.

breakpoints.name: admin-grid
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: admin card grids collapse to one column.

breakpoints.name: admin-nav
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: admin sidebar becomes a horizontal nav strip.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view, such as Send to phone.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4Z"/><path d="M22 2 11 13"/></svg>Send to phone</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font:600 0.8125rem/1 var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent, #1765cc);color:var(--on-accent, #ffffff);}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover, #1257b3);box-shadow:var(--shadow-1, 0 1px 2px rgba(32,38,45,0.18), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(32,38,45,0.08));}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #1765cc);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions beside a primary; outlined pill with blue text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font:600 0.8125rem/1 var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);cursor:pointer;background:var(--surface, #ffffff);border-color:var(--border-strong, #c7cbd1);color:var(--accent, #1765cc);}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:var(--accent-soft, #e6effc);}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #1765cc);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis actions such as Cancel or Back to the map.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font:600 0.8125rem/1 var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);cursor:pointer;background:transparent;color:var(--text-2, #565d66);}.ds-btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--surface-3, #eceef1);color:var(--text, #1d2126);}.ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #1765cc);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Panel search and route endpoints: borderless Mist fill that lifts to white with a blue halo on focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input placeholder="Search places" aria-label="Search places"></label>
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-2, #f5f6f8);border:1px solid transparent;color:var(--text-3, #6f7680);transition:border-color 120ms,background-color 120ms,box-shadow 120ms;width:320px;}.ds-search input{flex:1;min-width:0;height:42px;border:none;background:transparent;outline:none;font:400 0.9375rem var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);color:var(--text, #1d2126);}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--text-3, #6f7680);}.ds-search:focus-within{background:var(--surface, #ffffff);border-color:var(--accent, #1765cc);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, #e6effc);}

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields in settings, auth and admin.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;width:280px;font-family:var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);}.ds-field-label{font-size:0.8125rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-2, #565d66);}.ds-input{min-height:40px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong, #c7cbd1);background:var(--surface, #ffffff);color:var(--text, #1d2126);font:400 0.9375rem var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);transition:border-color 120ms,box-shadow 120ms;}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--text-3, #6f7680);}.ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent, #1765cc);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, #e6effc);}

components.name: Planner Tabs
components.description: Icon-over-caption tab strip in the floating panel; active tab takes a 3px blue underline.
components.html: DirectionsCoverage
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, #dfe2e6);width:240px;font-family:var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);}.ds-tab{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:2px;flex:1;padding:8px 4px 10px;color:var(--text-2, #565d66);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;transition:color 120ms,border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);}.ds-tab:hover{color:var(--text, #1d2126);}.ds-tab.is-active{color:var(--accent, #1765cc);border-bottom-color:var(--accent, #1765cc);}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #1765cc);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggle filters such as place categories; pressed chips turn Blue Wash.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;}.ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:30px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong, #c7cbd1);background:var(--surface, #ffffff);color:var(--text-2, #565d66);font:500 0.8125rem var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);cursor:pointer;}.ds-chip:hover{background:var(--surface-2, #f5f6f8);}.ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft, #e6effc);border-color:transparent;color:var(--accent, #1765cc);}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #1765cc);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Two-to-three-way choices such as Drive / Walk.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:inline-flex;padding:3px;gap:2px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface-3, #eceef1);}.ds-seg button{min-height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:none;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-2, #565d66);font:600 0.8125rem var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);cursor:pointer;}.ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--surface, #ffffff);color:var(--text, #1d2126);box-shadow:var(--shadow-1, 0 1px 2px rgba(32,38,45,0.18), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(32,38,45,0.08));}.ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #1765cc);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Route Option (explore, selected)
components.description: Signature card: swatch, title, km and hatched new-ground badge, duration with extra minutes; selected explore takes a green ring.
components.html: Explore 141 km 32 km you've never been49 min+12 min
components.css: .ds-route{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:360px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--border, #dfe2e6);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface, #ffffff);font-family:var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;transition:border-color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);}.ds-route:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong, #c7cbd1);background:var(--surface-2, #f5f6f8);}.ds-route.is-selected{border-color:var(--explore, #0b7d56);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--explore, #0b7d56);}.ds-route-swatch{display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;background:var(--explore-soft, #e3f3ec);color:var(--explore, #0b7d56);}.ds-route-body{flex:1;min-width:0;display:grid;gap:3px;}.ds-route-title{font-weight:600;font-size:0.9375rem;color:var(--text, #1d2126);}.ds-route-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:0.8125rem;color:var(--text-2, #565d66);}.ds-route-time{display:grid;justify-items:end;gap:2px;font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-2, #565d66);}.ds-route-time strong{font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:650;color:var(--text, #1d2126);}.ds-badge-new{display:inline-flex;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--explore, #0b7d56);background-color:var(--explore-soft, #e3f3ec);background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--explore, #0b7d56) 9%,transparent) 0 2px,transparent 2px 6px);}

components.name: Map Zoom Control
components.description: Floating map control group: 40px white squares with the resting shadow, split by a hairline.
components.css: .ds-mapctl{display:inline-grid;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface, #ffffff);box-shadow:var(--shadow-1, 0 1px 2px rgba(32,38,45,0.18), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(32,38,45,0.08));overflow:hidden;}.ds-mapctl button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border:none;background:var(--surface, #ffffff);color:var(--text-2, #565d66);cursor:pointer;}.ds-mapctl button+button{border-top:1px solid var(--border, #dfe2e6);}.ds-mapctl button:hover{color:var(--text, #1d2126);background:var(--surface-2, #f5f6f8);}.ds-mapctl button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #1765cc);outline-offset:2px;}

narrative.overview:
Wayfinder plays the map-app category straight, at the craft level of Google Maps and Apple Maps on the web. The map fills the viewport and the interface floats over it: near-white panels with 12px corners and a soft two-layer shadow, system UI type, neutral greys, and a single blue that means "act here" or "fastest". Nothing decorates the chrome. The map carries the colour and the panel carries the numbers.

The product-specific idea is that novelty is data. Kilometres you have never travelled sit beside minutes and kilometres as a first-class figure, in a second hue (explore green) that always arrives with a second channel: a dashed line on the map, a hatched badge in the panel, words in the label. Blue solid is the fastest route; green dashed is the invitation.

Density suits desk planning: 13 to 15px working text, tabular numerals, compact 30 to 40px controls, 8px list gaps. The admin area (/admin) uses the same tokens in a conventional sidebar-plus-cards layout with dense tables and line or bar charts. Light and dark themes are full peers: both follow the system setting and can be overridden with `data-theme`. The Android app mirrors these tokens in `apps/mobile/src/lib/theme.ts`; it consumes this system but is not documented here.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed map with floating surface chrome (400px panel, 16px inset).
One blue accent for primary actions, selection and the fastest route; one green for explore routes and new ground.
Novelty is never signalled by colour alone: dashed lines, hatched badges, explicit "km you've never been" text.
System UI type throughout, weights 400/550/600/650, tabular numerals for every figure.
Pill-shaped actions, 8px controls and cards, 12px floating panels.
Soft ambient shadows only on things that float; in-panel content is flat and separated by 1px borders.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Route Blue marks exactly three things: the primary action, the current selection, and the fastest route. It never decorates, and it never marks an explore route.

rules.name: The Two Channels Rule
rules.body: Explore Green is always paired with a non-colour signal: a dash pattern on the map, a hatched fill on the badge, or the words "new" / "you've never been". Remove the green and the meaning must survive.

rules.name: The Chart Slot Rule
rules.body: Charts take colour from the series slots, never from accent or explore, so data never borrows the meaning of an action or a route.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change or be compared (durations, distances, new km, table cells, chart axes, the budget readout) uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: UI labels, headings, tabs and admin nav group titles are sentence case at their normal tracking. Emphasis comes from weight, not capitals or letterspacing. (Uppercase appears only in basemap state labels, a cartographic convention.)

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to things that hover over the map or page. Cards inside a panel (route options, place cards, run lists) are bordered, never shadowed.

dos: Do float every piece of map chrome on Paper White with the resting (controls) or raised (panels, menus, dialogs) shadow, inset 16px from the viewport edge.
Do show every route comparison as minutes, km and new km together, with durations in tabular title-small.
Do draw fastest routes solid in Route Blue and explore routes dashed in Trail Green, each on a light casing so they read over any basemap.
Do pair every use of Explore Green with a dash, a hatch or explicit "new" wording.
Do use pills for actions and chips, 8px for fields and in-panel cards, 12px for floating surfaces.
Do read the product name from runtime config in the brand slot; the brand mark is an inline SVG.
Do define each new colour in both themes, flipping on-colour text to dark over the lighter dark-theme accents.
Do honour reduced motion; all transitions sit between 120 and 260ms on the ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).
donts: Don't use Route Blue for explore routes, decorative icons or chart series.
Don't encode route type, novelty or coverage by hue alone.
Don't shadow cards that sit inside a panel; use the 1px Hairline border and selection ring.
Don't add a display or brand typeface, uppercase UI labels or letterspaced labels; hierarchy comes from weight and size in the system UI stack.
Don't hard-code hex values in components; take them from the tokens so both themes follow.
Don't stretch phone patterns onto the desk layout; the bottom sheet is for widths below 900px only.
